Protein Food

Sardine

About This Entry

Sardine is small oily fish — grilled whole with lemon. Portuguese and Mediterranean whites, Txakoli, and dry rosé are classic.

Beginner Guide

Fresh sardines differ sharply from canned — delicate, not fishy when very fresh.

FAQ

What is Sardine?
Fresh sardines differ sharply from canned — delicate, not fishy when very fresh.
How should Sardine be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
